messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Moi Timo, I am at OULU-03 right now. Just a heads up that the key moved, it's in the site cabinet now. No need to go to the farm any more to open the access road barrier.

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Ah nice, thanks, good to know. That saves some driving next time 👍
